description: Exact-source two-process compatibility drill proving that a pinned historical candidate and current Import API can mutate and replay the same persisted Apply idempotency claims on one current expanded PostgreSQL schema. The candidate remains explicitly non-release evidence.
requiredScenarios: current-issued session invokes historical candidate Apply for Preview A
current process replays the exact historical-candidate idempotency claim for Preview A
historical-candidate-issued session invokes current Apply for Preview B
historical candidate replays the exact current idempotency claim for Preview B
reusing Preview A idempotency key for Preview B is rejected as conflict
exactly two applied claims and two memory items remain with no in-progress claim
abortCriteria: old backend is not the pinned full SHA or is not an ancestor of current source
either process fails to build or become healthy
current migration sequence cannot apply cleanly
synthetic Preview cannot be committed through the current Preview committer
either first Apply fails to create exactly one memory item
either opposite process cannot replay the original Apply ID
same idempotency key can be reused for another Preview
any Apply claim remains in progress
result would contain a token, database URL, account, job, Preview or idempotency identifier
limitations: historical candidate is not an approved predecessor release
sequential mutation and replay rather than concurrent claim racing
no process death during in-progress Apply
no rolling traffic drain or application rollback
no destructive contract migration or downgrade
